channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nick Collison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nick Collison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Nick Collison, Damien Wilkins
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Russell Westbrook on who taught him leadership:

“Nick Collison. Nick Collison taught me so much. Also, Damien Wilkins... not just about basketball, I learned about finances, stuff outside of basketball.”

Russell Westbrook on Nick Collison, Damien Wilkins, Dec 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Nick Collison
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Nick Collison getting his number retired in OKC last night:

“I would have loved to have been there just to support, because I owe him a lot. He's one of my dear friends. ... What he's about is what every player needs to be about.”

Scott Brooks on Nick Collison, Mar 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett
item.description:
“No matter if they talk to me or they're mad at me. Whether it's Sam Presti or Troy Weaver or Russell Westbrook or Nick Collison. Whether it's Wilson Taylor or Clay Bennett and his family, I love them from the bottom of my heart. We're not talking, but eventually we will.”

Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Ronnie Price on Nick Collison
item.description:
Alex Joseph:Ronnie Price:

“Nick Collison is a quiet leader. He's already established that. I'll be able to step in and handle that, as well.”

Ronnie Price on Nick Collison, Sep 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @alex_broseph.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Durant told The Vertical on Thursday.

“I didn’t say that – words about me telling Russell or Nick that I would stay or leave never came out of my mouth. We met as teammates, but no promises came out of it. In this day and age, I can’t control anything people claim out there. Someone can go out and say something random right now, and people will believe it. I never told Russell or Nick [Collison], ‘All right, guys, I’m coming back to the Thunder’ – and then a week later, I decide not to. Never happened. I don’t operate like that. I heard people say that story, but it’s not the truth.”

Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Russell Westbrook, Jul 28, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Sam Presti on Nick Collison
item.description:
Quote from Sam Presti on the Nick Collison extension via team press release:

“We are excited that Nick Collison will continue his tenure with the Thunder. Since our arrival in 2008, Nick has helped us establish the standards on and off the floor that we work by on a day-to-day basis,”

Sam Presti on Nick Collison, Feb 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.
